LESSON: HUMAN SEXUALITY

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living
Topic 5.2: Human Sexuality
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Human Sexuality, part of Christian Living in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How can you avoid irresponsible sexual behaviour?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe biblical teachings on responsible sexual behaviour,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Human Sexuality in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. outline the causes of irresponsible sexual behaviour among the youth,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Human Sexuality in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. identify values and life skills required to avoid irresponsible sexual behaviour,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Human Sexuality in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. respect his or her body as the temple of the Holy Spirit.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Human Sexuality in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
